feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iteration 9 (wheel_track 0.10 m, ±0.04 m row, kp 3.0) scored 36.6227. Iteration 8 (same row at 0.12 m) scored 36.3097, and iteration 6 scored the same, so the wider row removed no line loss. Iteration 7 showed that mass 0.5 kg cut slalom oscillation (0.1435 against 0.1625) but also cut slalom progress (0.105 against 0.110) and the score (35.64 against 36.31), so mass 0.8 kg stays. Mass is the only lever that trades oscillation for progress. Iteration 3 showed a null effect for wheel_track 0.10 m at kp 2.0. The oval and s-bend have lost the line once with max_error near 0.061 m across every geometry family tested (iterations 1 to 9), and the 0.06 m off-track floor binds because body_width cannot lift it. Body_length has no dynamic effect in the contract, so it should not be tested. Next-race rules: (a) if the oval and s-bend still match iteration 9 to four decimals and slalom steering_oscillation falls below 0.16, keep this geometry and treat geometry as exhausted for line loss. (b) If slalom steering_oscillation stays above 0.16 with kd 0.2, the remaining oscillation lever is a mass midpoint, not a track change. (c) If the oval or s-bend line loss moves below one, record that as the first geometry-independent change and keep the platform.
